title: Los Alamos hiring during a nuclear arms race

tellings.quote: She said, "There's a huge nuclear arms race going on right now, and they're building bombs like mad."

plain: Los Alamos, the New Mexico weapons laboratory, is said to be hiring hard in the 2020s because, in the words of a woman the writer Greg Bishop quotes, "There's a huge nuclear arms race going on right now, and they're building bombs like mad." Bishop passes on what she told him and does not name her, and he tells it as a sign of how busy the bomb work has become again.
